snippet.title: Who's at the Door? | Teaser Trailer | Steam PC
snippet.description:
Add to your wishlist Who's at the Door on Steam now. https://store.steampowered.com/app/3690010/Whos_at_the_door/

You are trapped in a small house with psychosis.
Observe carefully. Survive the 8-day loop. 3 runs. 3 endings.

It’s a simple routine:
Hallucinations come every day. Wait.
If they don’t go away, take your meds.
If they fade, open the door.

July, 2025
